scientific_integrity: The nonequivariant homotopy theorem is attributed to an earlier published result. The new statement is a complete rational character, irreducible decomposition, and cohomology of natural quotients. Proof uses complete finite enumeration and exact calculations; no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact rational homology character of the ordinary matching complex of one twelve-vertex graph. No integral equivariant lattice or quotient torsion computation; no extension to other graphs; publication priority beyond inspected evidence not established.
title: Full tetrahedral symmetry of truncated-tetrahedral matching homology
